audit.why: Seraphine wins levels 1-6 on poke/sustain/Encore all-in while Smolder is stackless and short-ranged; Smolder flips at first item once his Q ramps.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) despite this being the field meant to carry them.
audit.why: Flap, Flap, Flap is 24/22/20/18/16s and Seraphine's own E (Beat Drop) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s — both decisive for engage timing and were missing.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldown numbers for both abilities.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smolder's Q true damage bypasses resistances, his R heals through chip, and his E ignores terrain to cut retreat — none of these reached the page (missingInteractions).
audit.why: These are the concrete reasons armor/MR stacking, no anti-heal timing, and holding Flash for damage instead of the E wall are all wrong plays here.
audit.corrected: Folded true-damage/anti-heal into breakdown.late and the terrain-E/Flash call into ahead.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].side and phases[4].side said 'Skill' while win[3]/win[4] already said 'Seraphine' — full and content layers disagreed on who wins those rows.
audit.why: A reader would see two different answers for who wins levels 4-6.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[3].side and phases[4].side to 'Seraphine' to match the already-correct win[3]/win[4]; the why text for both rows already reads as Seraphine winning, so no why rewrite was needed.

edits.before: - Smolder Flap, Flap, Flap: matchup-defining — The glide over terrain is his whole escape — engage in the window after it shows. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Beat Drop like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Flap, Flap, Flap is down 24s at rank 1, only 16s maxed — engage in the window right after it shows, not before. - Your own E (Beat Drop) resets in 11s early, 9s maxed; don't burn it before he's actually in root range. - His R (120-100s) goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: W shields, then heals once already shielded — cast it before trading so both procs land before his poke does.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: You have no dash — stand behind your support's peel or his true-damage Q chips you every single poke.

edits.before: You conduct: R through your front line into theirs, echo the heals, and root the charmed remainder.
edits.after: You conduct: R through their line, buy Grievous Wounds for his chip-heal R, and root the charmed remainder.

edits.before: Ahead, raise the volume: echo Smolder off every contact, chain the picks, and encore the objections closed.
edits.after: Ahead, hold Flash for his E terrain, not the damage — chain picks off every echo and close it with Encore.

notes: His Q (Super Scorcher Breath) deals true damage per the kit flag, so armor/MR stacking is the wrong itemization answer against him specifically; folded that and his R's sustain into breakdown.late instead of adding a third report[] entry to stay inside the report-sweep cap. mirrorAlreadyAudited=false, so nothing to reconcile against the reverse page.
